evaluated condition

  • CURIE: gmeow:evaluatedCondition
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/evaluatedCondition
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

The condition this evaluation reports on (⊑ observedFeature — the bridge idiom). Functional: one evaluation, one condition; group members get their own evaluations.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ConditionEvaluation -> gmeow:Condition; functional Sub-property of: gmeow:observedFeature

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:evaluatedCondition from gmeow:ConditionEvaluation to gmeow:Condition when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:observedFeature, gmeow:ConditionEvaluation, gmeow:Condition
